connector.name: Canvas Parent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Canvas LMS (Instructure) for Claude - courses, grades, assignments, planner, files
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package canvas-parent-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
env.description: Canvas instance base URL, e.g. https://cms.instructure.com

env.name: CANVAS_USERNAME
env.description: Canvas login username/email (recommended) — pair with CANVAS_PASSWORD for auto-login. No SSO/2FA.

env.name: CANVAS_PASSWORD
env.description: Canvas password (recommended) — required iff CANVAS_USERNAME is set

env.name: CANVAS_TOKEN
env.description: Canvas personal access token (advanced) — most schools have disabled token creation

env.name: CANVAS_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Canvas OAuth client ID (advanced — for SSO accounts that can't use username/password)

env.name: CANVAS_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Canvas OAuth refresh token (advanced) — bootstrap via canvas-parent-mcp-qr-login

env.name: CANVAS_NAME
env.description: Friendly name for the Canvas instance (defaults to the host portion of the base URL)
